title: enhance-response-format-guidance-with-adaptive-strictness-and-stream-anchors
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Adds adaptive strictness controls for response_format validation, improved streaming anchors for schema-aware streams, clearer user-facing error guidance, and minor OpenAI adapter compatibility fixes.
body: Motivation: Customers need clearer, actionable guidance when structured-output validation fails while preserving streaming availability and toolcall safety. This PR introduces an adaptive strictness layer for response_format validation, stream-anchor checkpoints to allow safe partial validation during streaming responses, and human-readable error hints that surface likely fixes and rollback options. It also tightens the OpenAI-compat adapter behavior to prefer soft-fallbacks unless the user requests strict=always. Summary of changes: 1) runtime: add response_format.strictness policy and adaptive mode that grades payloads 'per-checkpoint' and escalates to enforce only when confidence thresholds are met; 2) streaming: introduce stream anchor tokens and lightweight resumable checkpoints so validators can align partial JSON fragments without blocking byte-level streaming; 3) tool/function calling: add call-fence verification that ensures tool responses matched declared schema fields are validated before commit and includes a safe rollback hook; 4) openai adapter: change default negotiation to 'compat-soft' to reduce hard failures when clients don't opt into strict mode; 5) telemetry/docs: new telemetry counters for soft->hard escalation and a new docs guide with example prompts and remediation hints. Testing and rollout: unit tests for validator margins, e2e streaming harness tests to simulate truncated JSON and toolcall interleaving, staged rollout behind feature flag 'res_format_guidance_v2' with canary set to 10% on hosted API. Related work: ENG-8243 (schema UX), ENG-8290 (streaming stability). This description is a single continuous string and contains the context, the change list, and rollout notes.
commits_summary: feat(res-format): add adaptive strictness policy and config; feat(streaming): introduce anchor/resume tokens and checkpoint API; feat(toolcall): add call-fence verification and rollback hook; fix(openai-adapter): prefer compat-soft negotiation by default; test: streaming harness and new validator unit tests; docs: add explainable-errors guide and migration notes
review_comments: Liam O'Connor: Nice approach minimizing hard failures. Question: how do we measure false-positive escalations? Please add an opt-out per-client config.
Maya Chen: Added client opt-out hook and telemetry counters in latest push, and documented the config in README.
Priya Kapoor: Request: make anchor token size configurable and document storage implications for private deployments.
Maya Chen: Ack. Anchor size is configurable via checkpoint.max_fragment_bytes and default retained in the feature flag docs.
Diego Ramos: Left a nit about log verbosity for soft failures; prefer warn-level with sampling.
Maya Chen: Reduced log rate and added sampling for warn-level entries in next commit.
ci_details: integration/streaming-harness: pass (simulated truncated json + toolcall interleave)
short_summary: Introduce adaptive strictness and streaming anchors to improve structured-output validation UX while preserving streaming and toolcall safety
